values.website:
Smart Metering & Utility Data Collection using eSIM
Remote Equipment Monitoring using dual profile eSIM
Kiosk & Self-Service Terminal Connectivity using Multi profile eSIM
values.catalogue:
Smart Metering & Utility Data Collection using eSIM — Ideal for smart electricity, water, and gas metering applications, enabling secure transmission of field data through cellular connectivity and RS485 integration.
Remote Equipment Monitoring using dual profile eSIM — Can be deployed to monitor pumps, generators, vending machines, and industrial equipment at remote locations with real-time status updates and alerts.
Kiosk & Self-Service Terminal Connectivity using Multi profile eSIM — Provides stable and secure connectivity for kiosks, ticketing systems, and self-service terminals requiring lightweight edge networking and remote management.
